lyrics:
[SCENE: ALIEN RADIO TRANSMITTER - CALL-IN SHOW START]
[HOST VOICE: CAMP MOTIVATIONAL GURU, AMPLIFIED OVER INTERFERENCE]
[TEMPO: 132 BPM, RELENTLESS DISCO BASSLINE + FUZZ GUITAR GROOVE]
[SOUND EFFECT: DIAL TONE WARPING INTO AN ODD-METRIC HARP SWEEP]
[VOCAL: RAPID CABARET PATTER WITH OPERATIC VIBRATO]

Welcome back, listeners across the seventh curvature! You are tuned directly into Frequency Zero, the only late-night talk show broadcasting across the meat-space divide! I am your host, Zeta-9, and today we are tearing down the flimsy partitions of your pathetic earthly self-esteem! We are mixing morphogenesis with scrambled cheese and shaking out the mothballs of your finite little minds! If your reality is melting into shimmering chromatic triangles, you are doing it right! Let us take our first incoming transmission from the localized hold queue! Caller, you are live on the air! State your mutation and let us hustle that mindset toward total apotheosis!

[CALLER 1: HIGH-PITCHED NASAL DRONE, TREMBLING WITH ABERRANT SALIENCE]
[INSTRUMENTATION: ORGAN SWELLS, BRUSHED PERCUSSION, DEAFENING COWBELL ACCENTS]

Zeta-9! Oh, thank the void, you picked up! I was staring at my kitchen table for four standard rotations and the wood grain started whispering prime numbers in a dialect of pure regret! I tried to eat my breakfast, but the cheese scrambled itself into a three-dimensional fractal moire pattern that refuses to acknowledge linear time! Every time I blink, my left shoe gains absolute moral jurisdiction over my thoughts! Is this personal growth or did I accidentally install a secondary nervous system into my toaster?

[HOST INTERRUPT: BLASTING AIR HORN, LAUGHING THEATRICALLY]
[VOCAL: GLAM ROCK BELT, UNAPOLOGETIC OVER-COMMITMENT]

Listen to me, caller! That is not a malfunction, that is a promotion! Your toaster is achieving enlightenment and you are lagging behind! You are suffering from low-grade dimensional constipation! What you call regret, the upper spheres call a high-yield aesthetic dividend! We are going to put you on hold right now while we run your domestic appliances through the metaphysical centrifuge! Do not touch your butter knife! We are coming back with more sparkling rainbow nonsense right after this station identification tone!

[STATION ID: SYNTHESIZED BIRDSONG CRASHING INTO A MOTORIK FUNK GROOVE]
[INSTRUMENTATION: SLAPPED UPRIGHT BASS, FUZZ ORGAN, DISTORTED HANDCLAPS]
[PHONETIC CHORUS: STACKED CLOSE-HARMONY VOCALS WITH RAPID CONSONANT CLICKS]

[Spoken rhythm, staccato, fast]
Spangle the grease! Mangle the cheese!
Wave the rainbow through the terminal breeze!
Moire patterns on the kitchen floor!
Knock twice on the interdimensional door!

[Sung, soaring melismatic arc]
Oh, let the structure bend and break!
For every choice you didn't make!
The cheese is scrambling! The rules are collapsing!
We are dancing on the edge of the abyss while laughing!

[HOST RETURN: DELIBERATELY DRAMATIC WHISPER INTO THE MICROPHONE]
[SOUND EFFECT: METALLIC GATE SLAMMING SHUT, TAPE SATURATION SPIKE]

We are back from the hold queue and our circuits are positively humming with radioactive radiance! Let us check the switchboard for another unfortunate soul trapped in a linear human life-cycle! Caller from sector four, your carrier wave is breaking up, but your emotional resonance is deafening! Speak your truth before your vocal cords turn into liquid geometry!

[CALLER 2: WHISPERED ENSEMBLE RHYTHM, MULTIPLE VOICES PANNING LEFT AND RIGHT]
[INSTRUMENTATION: VIBRAPHONE, SLOW TROMBONE GLISSANDOS, TICKING CLOCK SPEED-UP]

Zeta-9, my living room has been replaced by an upscale alien nightclub where the dancefloor is made of compressed anxiety and the drinks are served in inverted gravity wells! Nobody is dancing on their feet; they are undulating their secondary sensory cilia in 5/4 time! I tried to order a simple beverage, but the bartender demanded my cryptographic signature in exchange for a glass of shimmering optical illusion! I do not know where my hands are anymore! They smell like yesterday's thunderstorms and taste like copper coins!

[HOST LAUGH: OVER-THE-TOP OPERATIC CHUCKLE, DRUM FILL EXPLOSION]
[TEMPO SHIFT: SUDDEN HALT TO HALF-TIME STOMP WITH RAPID ORNAMENTAL SUBDIVISIONS]

Listen closely, you glorious sensory freak! That is not a nightclub, that is your new executive suite! You asked for morphogenesis and the universe delivered a full-course banquet of impossible architecture! Stop clinging to your boring old carbon-based proprioception! Shake those cilia! Embrace the moire sparkle! If your hands taste like thunderstorms, start conducting an orchestra of pure chaos right there on the sticky floor!

[BRIDGE: TOTAL STRUCTURAL FRACTURE AND COLLAPSE]
[INSTRUMENTATION: UNTUNED PERCUSSION, BOWED METAL, FEEDBACK SWELLS]

[Host, deadpan, clinical delivery]
Notice the precise angle of the spatial deformation.
Observe how the cheese refuses to stay within the boundaries.
We are crossing the phase threshold now.
Rules are no longer applicable.
Physics has resigned its commission.
Only the sparkle remains.

[FINAL CLIMAX: ANCHOR RETURNS AS A MASSIVE GLAM-DISCO ANTHEM]
[TEMPO RESTORED: 132 BPM, MASSIVE BRASS STABS, CHORUS OF HUNDREDS]

[Call-and-response choir]
[Host lead]
Are you sparkling yet?!
[Caller reply]
We are sparkling!
[Host lead]
Is the cheese scrambled yet?!
[Caller reply]
It is glowing!

[Outro: Fast scat singing, fading into interstellar static]
[SCENE END]
caption: An alien motivational call-in radio show broadcast live from an interdimensional nightclub, driven by manic disco grooves, cabaret patter, and campy theatrical excess. Callers struggle with morphing household objects, scrambled cheese, and aberrant salience as reality collapses into shimmering chromatic moire patterns under strict cosmic rules.
